title: VESPER Capability Grant
description: REM-003 §4.1, §4.3. There is no ambient authority: a subject holding no grant may act at L0 only. 'Default deny' is not a configuration setting -- it is the absence of any code path that produces a level without a grant. Authority: SR-014, SR-021, SR-022, SR-039, SR-049; INV-AUTH-1/2, INV-SELF-3.

kind.description: `runtime` is VESPER itself as a subject of its own change control (INV-SELF-1). Naming it here is what makes REM-004's boundary expressible: the corpus previously classified actions but never named the running system as a subject.

target_scope.description: Where the grant applies. `authorized` requires `target IN grant.target_scope`; an empty scope would authorize nothing, and a wildcard must be written as one, visibly.

delegable.description: INV-AUTH-2. Defaults false. L4 and L5 are NEVER delegable -- enforced structurally below. Unattenuated inheritance, not self-grant, was the real escalation path: a sub-agent summarising a web page must not hold its parent's L4.

issued_for_command_id.description: Binds L4/L5 to ONE command instance. INV-AUTH-2: a consumed L4 grant cannot authorize a second action. One confirmation authorizes one action -- not a task, not a session, and never six agents' worth of external action.

consumed_at_hlc.description: Set when a single-use grant is spent. A grant with consumed_at_hlc set is dead; re-presenting it is an audited denial, not a retry.

parent_grant_id.description: DF-ATTENUATE: child.grants must be a SUBSET of parent.grants. The link is recorded so the subset property is checkable after the fact, not only at issue time.

lease_epoch.description: REM-002. `authorized` requires the epoch to be current, so authority-at-time-of-action is reconstructible for A-018 and a grant issued under a fenced epoch is not honoured.

break_glass.description: REM-003 §4.6. Time-boxed, owner-authenticated, fully audited -- and it cannot be used to modify the PDP itself (REM-004). INV-SELF-3 holds even here: effective_level L5 with subject.kind == runtime is DENY, always, including under break-glass.

then.$comment: L4/L5 are never delegable and always bind to one command instance. Both are schema properties, so the escalation path is unexpressible rather than merely prohibited.

INV-SELF-3 as a schema property: an L5 grant to the runtime cannot be WRITTEN. DF-AUTHORIZE denies it at evaluation too -- two independent layers, because layer 4 (model disposition) is the layer prompt injection defeats.

$comment: EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: any `inherit_all` or `scope: *` shorthand. Attenuation must be explicit at every spawn; a shorthand for 'everything my parent had' is the exact defect DF-ATTENUATE exists to prevent.
